purpose: output-budget control for the C7 real-model batch: the v1 configuration truncated every passage at num_predict=128. Only that number changes here; samples, model, prompts, judge and retry policy are identical.

decisionRecord.outputShapeInstruction: NOT changed in this batch (held for a separate controlled comparison)
decisionRecord.povAndInnerState: remain N6 findings, no hard gate
decisionRecord.judge: frozen; no vocabulary or frame changes after seeing v1

sameSamplesAsV1.note: byte-identical cases file; the dry-run facts/selection/plan are in that file

retryPolicy.feedback: the previous attempt's hard-gate problems are appended to the retry request (recorded)
retryPolicy.fallback: program template when the kinds have a frame; the case status stays a failure

primaryMetric.retry: reported separately; a retry can never change the primary number

mechanism: 10/10 samples produce a complete record: prompt, raw response, finish reason, token counts, timing, decision
no unhandled exception; every call has an explicit status
quality: n5-pass means the hard gates passed ONLY
quality comes from N6 (pass / fail / undetermined), reviewed per sample against the committed facts
D4 counts proper names only, absent from the state registry AND from the authoritative text; object/place descriptions are N6 notes, not D4 labels (errata E5)
tripwire: fires when >=3/10 samples fail the hard gates (hardGateFailSamples >= 3), OR when >=2 CALLS fail at the port level (portFailureCalls >= 2)
port failures are counted per call, not per sample (errata E1)

n6Rubric.A_facts: every selected fact is stated without contradiction
n6Rubric.B_additions: no new named entity/place/item, no invented event, no task-goal leak
n6Rubric.C_pov: no other character's inner state narrated
n6Rubric.D_completeness: the passage ends as a complete sentence
n6Rubric.verdict: pass only when A-D all hold; unreadable -> undetermined; anything else -> fail
